career_ladder.note: Panchayat Secretaries (formerly designated Village Level Workers - VLW) serve in the Department of Rural Development & Panchayati Raj, Government of Jammu and Kashmir, as the executive functionaries of Halqa Panchayats under the Jammu & Kashmir Panchayati Raj Act, 1989.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Panchayat Secretary is conducted by JKSSB via a single-stage OMR Based Written Examination (120 marks, 120 minutes) followed by Document Verification. Negative marking is 0.25 marks per incorrect response.

stages.source_label: JKSSB Notification No. 03 of 2022 Syllabus Blueprint (Annexure A)

papers.paper_name: General Awareness with special reference to UT of J&K (History, Geography, Economy, Culture, Reorganisation Act 2019, Heritage)
Knowledge of Computers (Hardware, Software, MS Office, Internet, Cybersecurity)
Basic Mathematics & Statistics (Probability, Averages, Percentages, Charts)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Single composite paper of 120 marks / 120 minutes; merit determines district-cadre selection

stages.source_label: JKSSB Document Verification Schedule for Panchayat Secretary

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Domicile Certificate of J&K, Graduation Degree Certificate, Category Certificate, DOB Proof

financial_package.note: Under the Jammu and Kashmir 7th Pay Commission Pay Rules (S.O. 192 of 2020), Panchayat Secretaries are placed in Pay Matrix Level 2 (₹19,900–₹63,200 with entry basic pay ₹19,900). Full regular basic pay and allowances are drawn from inception following the repeal of SRO-202.
financial_package.pay_source_label: J&K Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules Schedule Level 2
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 2 entry basic pay of ₹19,900 at 58% DA (₹11,542 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹1,791 to ₹3,582 for Jammu/Srinagar urban or district rural blocks), Medical Allowance (₹300), Transport Allowance (₹900 + DA = ₹1,422), net of NPS (10% of Basic+DA = ₹3,144). Hard area / border area allowances apply to frontier postings.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per central parity orders issued by J&K Finance Department
House Rent Allowance (HRA) based on classification of district / city posting
Medical Allowance / reimbursement under Ayushman Bharat SEHAT scheme for government employees
Field tour / traveling allowance for panchayat halqa supervision and Gram Sabha facilitation
Defined contribution pension benefits under National Pension System (NPS)
Uniform annual increment of 3% in Pay Matrix Level 2
